purpose: Define the historical target, evidence hierarchy, native-size policy, runtime mapping, and honest review state for each icon appearance.
copyrightBoundary: Historical Apple artwork is evidence-only. Product runtime assets are project-owned reconstructions or adaptations; screenshots, extracted resources, traced Apple paths, and embedded Apple bitmaps do not ship as product icons.

statusModel.authoring: generated-draft and technically-clean describe production state only.
statusModel.historical: pending, historically-reviewed, and reference-validated are separate historical states recorded per icon and era in icon-provenance-matrix.json.
statusModel.familyCompleteness: A 56-object runtime family can be complete while historical review remains pending.
statusModel.remaining40: Every runtime id outside icon-system-continuity.json priorityCore16 remains pending until individually reviewed.

evidencePriority: target-OS native resources or real-system captures
same-period Apple HIG or developer documentation

classic.runtimeDefault: 32 px SVG; 16 px is selected for compact contexts
classic.runtimeFormat: smooth monochrome SVG artwork plus a separate smooth selection mask
classic.sizePolicy: The 32 and 16 compositions are separate optical targets. Retina-safe smoothing is permitted, but native evidence owns anatomy, occupied bounds, relative scale, asymmetry, internal landmarks, and selection-mask behavior wherever a direct counterpart exists.
classic.replicaPolicy: A direct runtime replica must compare closely with the native resource. Smooth curves are a display representation, not permission to replace native anatomy with a generic geometric icon. Exact-replica claims require an explicit overlay or diff; otherwise the asset is a reference-guided reconstruction.
classic.light: monochrome structural contrast; no material lighting recipe
classic.perspective: native System 6 object orientation and deliberately varied optical bounds
classic.edge: smooth Retina SVG edges under the current product direction; no grey fringe baked into the monochrome artwork
classic.authoringStatus: mixed deterministic reconstruction and generated draft; inspect icon-provenance-matrix.json per object
classic.historicalReviewStatus: mixed; direct native counterparts and reviewed adaptations are listed per object in icon-provenance-matrix.json
classic.remaining40Status: pending unless an id is explicitly included in priorityCore16 with a stronger status
classic.acceptance: Compare direct counterparts against their native resources before judging polish. Inspect 32 and 16 independently at runtime size and high-density scale; smoothing must not alter evidence-owned anatomy.

platinum.runtimeDefault: 32 px runtime mapping; 16 px compact and 42 px desktop artwork are ledger-declared review tiers
platinum.runtimeFormat: mixed SVG compatibility assets and PNG family artwork; the runtime manifest is authoritative per id
platinum.sizePolicy: A 16 px file is historically complete only when independently inspected or optically authored. ImageGen acceptance or the mere presence of 42/32/16 files does not prove this.
platinum.light: upper-left discrete highlight with lower-right structural shade
platinum.perspective: compact front or shallow three-quarter object view; removable media generally front-on
platinum.edge: integer-pixel geometry, selective dark keyline, hard alpha, no theme-wide filter shadow
platinum.authoringStatus: the broad family contains accepted ImageGen redraws and deterministic compatibility assets; acceptance is authoring/technical state only
platinum.historicalReviewStatus: mixed; do not treat accepted-imagegen or a historical prompt as historical validation
platinum.acceptance: Inspect 42, 32, and 16 at native display size and nearest-neighbour review zoom. Compare direct prototypes before palette tuning; reject both System 6-plus-grey and Windows-95-heavy bevels.

aqua.runtimeDefault: 32 px manifest mapping; the 128 px tier also feeds Retina desktop sprites
aqua.sizePolicy: The broad generated family stores deterministic review derivatives rather than independently authored compact artwork. An object-specific ledger may override that policy only when it explicitly records direct native-size construction. Presence of 128/32/16 files alone is not proof.
aqua.light: above and slightly toward the viewer, with bright early-Aqua highlight and object-owned cast shadow
aqua.perspective: genre-specific: user applications use desk perspective, utilities are straighter-on, documents hover, hardware has weight, and removable media is generally front-on
aqua.edge: anti-aliased illustrated material edge; no CSS gloss or global drop-shadow recipe
aqua.authoringStatus: the broad 56-object family is ImageGen-authored and technically accepted; object-specific deterministic historical overlays are recorded separately
aqua.historicalReviewStatus: mixed; accepted-generated does not mean historically-reviewed
aqua.acceptance: Assign genre before material. A 128 px master may establish illustration, but 32 and 16 must be judged independently and redrawn when anchors collapse. Finder must follow the Jaguar split-face prototype.

snow-leopard.runtimeDefault: 32 px manifest mapping; the 128 px tier also feeds Retina desktop sprites
snow-leopard.sizePolicy: For the broad generated family, 512/128/32/16 are deterministic review derivatives unless an object ledger explicitly records direct native-size drawing. A scaled 128 is not a detail-authored 512 master, and a reduced 128 is not automatically optical 32/16 artwork.
snow-leopard.light: controlled overhead key light with restrained ambient fill and an object-specific contact shadow
snow-leopard.perspective: mature OS X genre split: desk perspective for user applications, shelf or straight-on perspective for utilities, hovering paper for documents, front-on removable media
snow-leopard.edge: high-resolution material detail and subtle alpha; no shared Jaguar anatomy or theme-wide CSS shadow
snow-leopard.colorSpace: References are normalized to sRGB for browser review; source-profile provenance remains in the local evidence cache.
snow-leopard.periodCaution: Exported .icns sets may include tiers newer than 10.6.8. They may support only an object whose artwork is confirmed against a real 10.6.8 capture; the newer container itself is not 10.6 evidence.
snow-leopard.authoringStatus: the broad 56-object family is ImageGen-authored with deterministic derivatives; object-specific historical overlays must declare their own construction
snow-leopard.historicalReviewStatus: mixed; no broad core-reviewed claim is made
snow-leopard.acceptance: The family must read as mature 10.6 illustration, not a quieter Jaguar pack. Judge 512, 128, 32, and 16 separately, with direct attention to material detail at large size and anchor survival at compact sizes.

yosemite.runtimeDefault: 32 px manifest mapping with 128 px artwork used by Retina desktop contexts
yosemite.sizePolicy: The broad generated family stores deterministic 128/64/32/16 review derivatives unless an object ledger explicitly records optical construction. Compact variants require redraw when reduction creates modern uniform strokes or loses object identity.
yosemite.light: soft frontal-upper light with shallow shading and no skeuomorphic cast-shadow theatre
yosemite.perspective: flattened but object-specific Finder and application silhouettes with Retina hairlines and compact optical centres
yosemite.edge: clean anti-aliased fills, light steel-blue keyline, limited gradients, no family-wide squircle or outline-glyph pack
yosemite.containerRule: Only objects whose real 10.10 prototypes use a rounded container may use one. There is no family-wide squircle.
yosemite.authoringStatus: the broad 56-object family is ImageGen-authored with deterministic derivatives; object-specific historical overlays are separate
yosemite.historicalReviewStatus: mixed; accepted-generated does not mean the icon belongs in a 2014 Applications folder
yosemite.acceptance: Reject later-macOS squircles, SF-Symbol-like uniform linework, contemporary AI gradients, and excessively perfect geometry. Finder follows the real 10.10 split-face prototype, including its side relationship.

liquid-glass.runtimeDefault: 128 px Default artwork is runtime-mapped; Dark, Clear, and compact tiers are review assets unless an object-specific ledger says otherwise
liquid-glass.runtimeFormat: transparent PNG composites; core layered objects may retain separate source layers
liquid-glass.sizePolicy: The broad ImageGen family derives 64/32/16 and Dark/Clear review variants from its accepted master. A core object is independently complete only when its ledger names direct optical construction or layered source files. A reduced or appearance-tinted PNG must not be renamed as independent artwork.
liquid-glass.light: vertical light from above with crisp specular rims and object-owned contact shadows
liquid-glass.perspective: simple layered physical metaphors; system masking does not justify one indiscriminate squircle for every object
liquid-glass.edge: controlled translucent layers, refraction cues, and bright specular edges; no generic glassmorphism tile or uniform outline pack
liquid-glass.materialArchitecture: Identity, background, foreground, and accent layers are the preferred source architecture for core icons. Specular, refraction, translucency, and shadow belong to a shared painter; they should not exist only as one baked ImageGen master.
liquid-glass.referenceCutoff: Real macOS Tahoe 26 captures win over later revisions of Apple design guidance when visual parameters conflict. Current Apple documentation may explain the layer model but may not silently advance the target beyond Tahoe 26.
liquid-glass.limits: A static asset cannot sample the live desktop behind itself. Toolbar and sidebar symbols remain separate families and are not derived by simply scaling the application icon.
liquid-glass.authoringStatus: the broad family uses ImageGen masters and deterministic appearance/size derivatives; core layered overlays must declare their separate source architecture
liquid-glass.historicalReviewStatus: mixed; accepted-imagegen is not Tahoe reference validation
liquid-glass.acceptance: Every object must remain readable in Default, Dark, and Clear over varied backgrounds and must still look native to Tahoe 26 rather than generic glassmorphism.
